questions.stem: What is the role of companion cells in translocation?

options.text: They store excess sugars as starch
They carry out photosynthesis to produce sugars
They transport water alongside the sieve tubes
They provide energy via mitochondria to actively load sucrose into sieve tubes

questions.explanation: Companion cells have many mitochondria and provide the ATP needed to actively load sucrose into the sieve tube elements. This active loading requires energy because sucrose is moved against its concentration gradient.
